Pattern/camera/kick weights 40/30/30; default-normalized. Unsupported base firing protocols retain the legacy multiplier proxy. Experimental, not client-validated.
limitations: Pattern uses 20 post-shot source-chart points; not measured angular recoil. The scoring window is fixed independently of graph shot count. For candidate magazines below 20, this is an abstract profile comparison, not a continuous firing claim.

Time-limited best-found search. Legal combinations can remain unexplored; shortlists are not proven global top-K. The time budget covers attachment search, tactical search and calibration. Calibration uses legal-position source-scored coordinate refinement, not a global calibration proof.
